description_te: పిల్లలను బడికి పంపే తల్లులు/సంరక్షకురాళ్ళకు ₹15,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం. DBT ద్వారా తల్లి Aadhaar-seeded bank account కి credit.
description_en: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 per year to mothers/guardians who send their children to school. Paid through DBT to mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

eligibility_criteria.mother_or_guardian: Must be the mother or authorized female guardian
eligibility_criteria.children_enrolled: Children must be enrolled in classes 1-12 in govt, private aided/unaided, or recognized junior colleges
eligibility_criteria.attendance: Minimum 75% attendance in current academic year
eligibility_criteria.ration_card: At least one family member must hold valid rice card
eligibility_criteria.land: < 3 acres wet land OR < 10 acres dry land OR combined < 10 acres
eligibility_criteria.property: Cannot own ≥ 1,000 sq ft municipal property
eligibility_criteria.bank_account: Mother's account must be Aadhaar-seeded with NPCI validation
eligibility_criteria.special_cases: Orphans and street children enrolled through voluntary organizations eligible (subject to verification)
excluded: Households owning four-wheelers (except taxis, tractors, autos)
Central/State government or PSU employees or pensioners
Any family member paying income tax
Students in ITI, Polytechnic, IIIT (RGUKT), or fee-reimbursed courses

benefit_amount: ₹15,000 per annum per child (DBT to mother's account)
application_process_te:
1. సచివాలయంలో VRO/Welfare Assistant దగ్గర apply చేయండి
2. Documents verify చేయబడతాయి
3. GSWS portal లో online application submit అవుతుంది
4. DBT ద్వారా mother's bank account లో credit అవుతుంది
go_reference: GO Ms. No. 47, dated 28.12.2019 (original); relaunched as Thalliki Vandanam 12 June 2025
